name: Leave Type Settings shows an empty state with a create prompt

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'Leave Types' page via the sidebar link (URL /hr/leave-types).
Verify the empty state is shown: the page contains the heading 'No leave types configured' and a prompt about creating the first leave type to make it available in the employee request form.
